questions.question: Tell me about yourself.
questions.answer: My name is Adithya. I recently completed my BCA. I have learned Java programming, object-oriented programming and SQL. I completed academic projects using Java and MySQL. I am looking for an opportunity to start my software development career.

questions.question: Why do you want to become a Java Developer?
questions.answer: I am interested in Java because it is an object-oriented programming language. I enjoy solving programming problems and want to improve my backend development skills.

questions.question: How would you handle a task you have never done before?
questions.answer: First, I would understand the requirement. Then I would research the concept, try a small implementation and test it. If I need help, I would discuss it with an experienced team member.
